claims.text: The paper focuses on intent classification and entity recognition within cross-lingual natural language understanding (XNLU).
Intent classification is defined as identifying the type of user command, which is a primary focus of the study.
Entity recognition is also a key objective, identifying relevant entities in user utterances.
